-- Old id:1 (drills-hammers) → New id:16 (drills-hammer-drills)

-- Old id:3 (saws-cutting) → New id:18 (saws-cutting-tools)
UPDATE equipment_items SET subCategoryId = 18 WHERE subCategoryId = 3;
-- Old id:4 (fastening-nailing) → New id:19 (impact-fastening)
UPDATE equipment_items SET subCategoryId = 19 WHERE subCategoryId = 4;
-- Old id:5 (scaffolding-systems) → stays as id:5 (same)
-- Old id:6 (mobile-towers) → stays as id:6 (same)
-- Old id:7 (ladders-steps) → stays as id:7 (same)
-- Old id:8 (aerial-platforms) → stays as id:8 (same)
-- Old id:9 (mig-tig-welders) → stays as id:9 (same)
-- Old id:10 (plasma-cutters) → stays as id:10 (same)
-- Old id:11 (oxy-acetylene) → New id:34 (oxy-acetylene-sets)
UPDATE equipment_items SET subCategoryId = 34 WHERE subCategoryId = 11;
-- Old id:12 (fall-protection) → stays as id:12 (same)
-- Old id:13 (ppe-clothing) → stays as id:13 (same)
-- Old id:14 (barriers-signage) → stays as id:14 (same)
-- Old id:15 (gas-detection) → stays as id:15 (same)

-- Now delete the old duplicates (keep id:2 grinders-sanders as it's still valid)
DELETE FROM equipment_sub_categories WHERE id IN (1, 3, 4, 11);
